CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2018 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2018 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 301 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 1 benchmark sites in 1 regions spanning 1 states (survey period: September 2018 to September 2018). These surveys captured 18 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 3 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 267 cards across 23 sites, with 13.5% showing evidence of mouse activity (36 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 104 transects across 23 sites (survey period: September 2018 to September 2018), detecting active burrows in 3.8% of transects (total: 5 active burrows).
